title: feat(app-shell): Studio home returns to the Studio landing; the two Setup exits say so
body:
Fixes #12513
Clause-②: no

## What changed

**Target 1: the header's first button returns to the Studio landing.** In the shell header of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the first button now navigates to `/studio` (the `BuilderLanding` page) instead of the deployment's home path. It keeps the `confirmLeavePillar()` gate. It is titled "Studio home" (new key `engine.studio.landingHome`) and carries the new testid `studio-home`. The console home is one click further, through the landing's own top bar. `StudioRoute.tsx` needed no change: `/studio` already renders the landing.

**Target 2: the package switcher's first row is "Studio home".** `PackageSwitcher` gets a new first row (testid `studio-switcher-home`) above the package list. It is gated by `beforeNavigate` like the other rows. The deleted-package eviction is unchanged.

**Target 3: the two Setup exits say so.**
- On the landing, each installed card's link (testid `studio-landing-overlay`, unchanged) reads "Open in Setup" with an outward arrow (`ArrowUpRight`). I reworded the en and zh values of the existing key `engine.studio.landing.overlay`. Its route and its overlay tooltip (`engine.studio.landing.overlayTitle`) are unchanged.
- The empty Organization flows block (`StudioEmptyState`, `auto-empty`) gets an "Open in Setup" link as its `action` (new key `engine.studio.org.openSetup`, new testid `auto-empty-open-setup`). It is a link, not a create button, since this scope creates nothing. A package's own empty block is unchanged.
- The link's route is measured, not invented. The Setup app's nav entry `nav_packaged_automation` (objectstack `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts`) names the component ref `automation:packaged`. app-shell registers that ref in `builtinComponents`, and the console serves it at `/apps/setup/component/automation/packaged`. The link builds that URL from the ref with `componentRefToUrlSegments`, the same helper `PackagedAutomationPage.navContribution.test.tsx` pins. In the live console, following it opens the Setup page headed "Packaged automation".

**Retired key.** `engine.studio.home` ("Back to home" / "返回主页") is removed from the en and zh designer tables. After the header change nothing reads it, and `check:i18n-dead-keys` no longer lists it.

No change to Setup. No existing testid was removed, and every i18n key that has a reader stays. New keys are in en and zh, the two halves of the designer table.

## Deviations

- `StudioDesignSurface.pillarNavGuard.test.tsx`: its Home-button case clicked "Back to home" and expected `/home`. Target 1 changes both, so it now clicks "Studio home" and expects the `/studio` landing. The cancel and confirm gate assertions are unchanged.

- `type-check`: exit 0. eslint on the touched files: exit 0, no errors.
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (no longer lists `engine.studio.home`) and `check-changeset-presence`: exit 0.

On `385fa92`, before the merge:
- New pins: `StudioDesignSurface.homeLoop-12513.test.tsx` (header button goes to `/studio`; the switcher's first row is Studio home and goes to `/studio`; the org empty block links to Setup > Packaged automation and offers no create button; control: a package's empty block has no Setup link) and `BuilderLanding.setupExit-12513.test.tsx` (label, outward arrow, unchanged route; the packaged-automation route built from its ref).
- Every `StudioDesignSurface.*.test.tsx` and `BuilderLanding.*.test.tsx`, including `BuilderLanding.accessibleNames-12510`: 88 files, 587 tests passed, exit 0.

- Ablations, each landed, turned red and was restored, with `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards: header destination changed to `/home`; switcher row destination changed to `/home`; the package-less action arm disabled; the en label reverted; the route spelled without `component/`.

## Acceptance notes

- A third Setup exit, the in-package read-only link ("Read-only · Customize with an overlay", `studio-readonly-link`), still goes to Setup without saying so. It is outside this card's two exits and its file surface, so it is noted here and not changed.
